digest.component_or_area: plan-review clarity measure and deterministic floor
propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author-guide section contract, allowing padded tickets to pass without required Approach, grounded Scope, or per-criterion verification.
Clarity logic is duplicated across _engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, creating maintenance and drift risk.

Recommended deterministic additions include required-section shape by graph altitude, per-AC verification coverage parsing, placeholder-free scope detection, and structured file_impact grounding for leaf plans.
Per-AC verification must detect operator-attestation markers or explicit proving clauses rather than relying on semantic judgment.

Testing shape checks and AC text hygiene should flag placeholder language and independent bundled outcomes deterministically while preserving LLM review for mechanism correctness and alternative rationale.

Author-guide conflict exists between Success Criteria requirement for containers and test inertness, and between rejected-alternative naming versus positive-rationale-only guidance; scoring should reflect only nonempty Approach pending bug resolution.
